Package index

Test

Every pair of cell types, between conditions or with survival.

spicy()
Test for changes in the co-localisation of cell types between conditions
SpicyResults-class SpicyResults
The results of spicy()
topPairs()
A table of the significant results from spicy tests
bind()
The per-image values of every pair, as a data frame

Plot

signifPlot()
Plots result of signifPlot.

Box plot of one pair, with a point per image
plotImage()

Per-image statistics (image method)

Inputs and helpers for spicy(method = "image"), the original spicyR test.

getPairwise()
Get statistic from pairwise L curve of a single image.
getPairwiseProp()
Observed/expected proportion ratio for a fixed-k neighbourhood
getProp()
Get proportions from a SummarizedExperiment.
convPairs()
Converts colPairs object into an abundance matrix based on number of nearby interactions for every cell type.
colTest()
Perform a simple wilcoxon-rank-sum test or t-test on the columns of a data frame
